title: feat(skills): unify installed and ClawHub discovery

commit.messageHeadline: feat(skills): expose registry identity and browse trending skills
feat(ui): unify Skills discovery and installed settings
improve(ui): polish Skills scope, controls, and workshop navigation
refactor(ui): isolate Skills view contracts and inherit control cursors
test(ui): exercise Skills management through unified discovery

No blocking introduced defect was found, and the inspected visual evidence supports the UI changes. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `bdbdc77a63968338082e74c4e0c58fb191d41090` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A coherent implementation with useful visual proof and focused lifecycle coverage; no blocking defect was identified. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected desktop/mobile before-and-after Control UI screenshots directly demonstrate the new discovery renderer and navigation with synthetic fixtures; the captured body also reports isolated-Gateway and live-ClawHub exercise, with focused tests as supplemental evidence. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Verified | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected desktop/mobile before-and-after Control UI screenshots directly demonstrate the new discovery renderer and navigation with synthetic fixtures; the captured body also reports isolated-Gateway and live-ClawHub exercise, with focused tests as supplemental evidence. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Introduced discovery behavior: The projection merges listings only with valid installed provenance matching both registry and source-qualified reference; local cards remain independent of registry availability.
Lifecycle and destination coverage: Inspected tests cover previous-agent response rejection, same-client reconnects, and withholding installation until the personal-versus-workspace destination is known. These tests were read, not executed.
External contract dependency: The introduced empty-query branch directly calls ClawHub’s Trending API and maps publisher.handle, install references, and metrics.updatedAt; this establishes the relevant ClawHub dependency boundary. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The Skills page combines the selected agent’s installed skills, personal libraries, and ClawHub results. Its cards lead into existing detail, configuration, and installation flows through the Gateway. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Selected agent] --> B[Installed skills and libraries] C[Search query] --> D[Gateway search or Trending] B --> E[Identity-aware discovery cards] D --> E E --> F[Skill details and settings] E --> G[Existing installation flow] ``` ## Before merge None.
Agent review details ### Security None. ### PR surface Source +303, Tests +678, Docs 0, Other 0. Total +981 across 48 files.

### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test growth** | Production net +303 lines; tests/support net +678 lines | The body justifies production growth with the discovery projection, renderer, identity matching, and separate settings route. | | **Protocol result fields** | 1 required registry field and 1 optional publisher field added | These fields carry discovery identity from the Gateway without introducing a configuration or storage migration. | ### Technical review Best possible solution: Maintain one discovery projection over existing inventory and registry owners, with configuration and installation consent retained in their established flows. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Not applicable as a feature proposal; current-main source and before captures establish the split discovery experience. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes. The implementation reuses existing registry mapping, settings, library, and installation owners while replacing the competing discovery controls. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`ui/src/pages/skills/route.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1391f7cd2d40ab5bbcf2f5f831d3a64f520e72d7/ui/src/pages/skills/route.ts), [1391f7cd2d40](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1391f7cd2d40ab5bbcf2f5f831d3a64f520e72d7)) Likely related people: - **Patrick-Erichsen:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality.
